page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; text in one block of verse and short epigrams with headings between rules; page number top right; signature O 4 at foot left.

p.i: Fudirit, expreßis totidem facra pagina verbis Non docet: at legimus non certo auctore relata, Sancta tamen, quasi no fuderit ipse Manasses, At Deus ipse illi poßit dicta ße videri. Herconuper qua quum tibi texta, Paludi, Carmine perlegerem, laudavi, & sic ego mecum Ipse loquens, utinam Deus, inquam, Maxime, nunquam Vel talis nostro nascatur in orbe Manasses, Vel si natus erit, paucos aut regnet in annos, Aut alter fiat, mutata mente, Manasses.

main_text.head: Ioannes Paludius Philophilus Theo-doro Bezæ.
main_text.p: Is pueros, dixere, senes: oppono senectam Bezæ ego Noftoreã: bis mihi Beza Vir est.
main_text.head: Beza Ioanni Paludio Philophilo.
main_text.p: Is tibi Beza Vir est, Num quod bis Beza maritus, Nulla probat proles quæ tamen esse Virum?
main_text.head: Ioannes Paludius Philophilus pro valetudine Bezæ.
main_text.p: Qui tibi seruiuit tot, Chrifte, fideliter annos, Ipse tua Bezam, quaso, tuere manu:

page.notes: Printed text is partly italic and partly roman; the last signature line "O 4" is the gathering mark. Some words in the first epigram and the second epigram are doubtful, e.g. "Noftoreã", "oppono", "Vir" and "Virum" (long s and u/v forms). Fragment at line-end "Fudirit" and "Hercon uper qua" kept as printed.
